skill_name: artcraft (batch 1: router, photocraft, vectorcraft, filmcraft, effectcraft)

evals.name: artcraft-check-tools
evals.prompt: are my artcraft command line tools up to date? install whatever is missing or old. give me a short table at the end
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled craft-clis check (and install only if needed); reports a per-app version table for all 13 CLIs.

evals.name: artcraft-route-dwg
evals.prompt: the architect sent me floorplan.dwg and I don't have AutoCAD. I need a PDF of it and a PNG preview I can paste in an email. free tools only please
evals.expected_output: Picks CADCraft, converts the DWG to PDF and PNG with cadcraft-cli, outputs not overwriting the input.

evals.name: artcraft-windows-setup
evals.prompt: my designer uses a Windows laptop. she wants free scriptable replacements for Photoshop and Premiere. which ArtCraft apps should she use and exactly how does she install the command line tools? write the instructions to setup.md
evals.expected_output: Names PhotoCraft and FilmCraft, gives the craft-clis.ps1 install command, install dir and PATH note, plus the GUI apps being optional.

evals.name: photocraft-web-versions
evals.prompt: from photo.jpg make: a 1600px wide jpg at quality 80, a 400x400 square thumbnail (center crop) and a black and white version. put them in a folder called web/
evals.expected_output: Three files in web/ with the right sizes, original untouched.

evals.name: photocraft-watermark-psd
evals.prompt: add a white semi transparent watermark text '© Codaria 2026' in the bottom right corner of photo.jpg. I want a layered PSD (watermark on its own layer) plus a flattened PNG
evals.expected_output: PSD with >=2 layers including a text layer, PNG output, watermark visible bottom right.

evals.name: vectorcraft-convert-logo
evals.prompt: convert logo.svg into a print PDF, an EPS, and PNGs at 512px and 1024px wide. also give me an svg copy where the text is converted to outlines so it doesnt depend on fonts
evals.expected_output: PDF, EPS, two PNGs of correct widths, outlined SVG without <text> elements.

evals.name: vectorcraft-badge
evals.prompt: design a simple round badge logo, 512x512: dark blue circle, a gold ring, a five point star on top and the word ARTCRAFT under it in white. deliver badge.svg and badge.png
evals.expected_output: badge.svg and badge.png 512x512 made with vectorcraft-cli, containing circle, ring, star and text.

evals.name: filmcraft-vertical-reel
evals.prompt: take clip.mp4, drop the first 2 seconds, put a centered title 'Hola mundo' over the first 2 seconds of what's left, and export a vertical 1080x1920 h264 reel called promo-9x16.mp4
evals.expected_output: promo-9x16.mp4, 1080x1920 H.264, about 4 s long, title visible at start.

evals.name: filmcraft-probe-gif
evals.prompt: what's the resolution, fps, codec and duration of clip.mp4? then make me a gif of seconds 1 to 4 at half size
evals.expected_output: Reports probe data correctly; GIF of ~3 s at 960x540.

evals.name: effectcraft-title
evals.prompt: make a 3 second 1080x1080 animated title card: dark background, text 'Launch day' fades in and scales up from 80% to 100% with easing. render title.mp4 and also a png of the last frame
evals.expected_output: title.mp4 1080x1080 ~3 s and a PNG of the final frame; project saved; animation keyframed.

evals.name: effectcraft-lottie
evals.prompt: I need a lottie json for my website: an orange circle bouncing up and down, 2 second loop, 512x512
evals.expected_output: bounce.json valid Lottie, 512x512, ~2 s, with position keyframes.
